title: NCAA: San Beda piles on Perpetual's woes, extends winning streak to 3 games
summary: San Beda stretched its winning streak to three games in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament after a 71-63 triumph over Perpetual Help, Thursday at the San Juan Arena.
